principle: A production agentic product needs a runtime kernel for scheduling, memory, tools, identity, observability, governance, recovery, budgets, roles, and human control.

kernel_components.name: Scheduler and Orchestrator
kernel_components.purpose: Prioritize foreground work, background routines, queues, concurrency, cancellation, and escalation.
p0_blockers: no priority model for live versus background work
routines can overlap unsafely
no queue or job owner

kernel_components.name: Memory Manager
kernel_components.purpose: Govern short-term, long-term, episodic, semantic, procedural, and tenant-specific memory.
p0_blockers: memory storage selected before memory type and owner are justified
hidden memory writes
no memory owner
unclear tenant or user boundary
no correction or deletion path

kernel_components.name: Tool Manager and Sandbox
kernel_components.purpose: Define tool registry, action classification, sandbox boundaries, dry-run mode, fixtures, and approval requirements.
p0_blockers: agent can mutate systems without approval
code execution has broad file or network access
tools can access secrets unnecessarily

kernel_components.name: Identity and Delegation Manager
kernel_components.purpose: Define who an agent acts for, which credentials and scopes are used, and how actions are attributed.
p0_blockers: external actions cannot be attributed to user and agent
tokens are long-lived without scope limits
service account can cross tenant boundaries

kernel_components.name: Observability and Trace Layer
kernel_components.purpose: Capture model routes, prompts, context, retrieval, tool calls, approvals, memory changes, external actions, cost, latency, and failures.
p0_blockers: bad outcome cannot be reproduced
tool inputs or retrieved context are not logged
approvals are not traceable

kernel_components.name: Guardrails and Governance
kernel_components.purpose: Enforce input, output, policy, prompt-injection, approval, escalation, and public/paid/destructive action rules.
p0_blockers: policy exists only in prompts
public/paid/destructive actions lack approval
untrusted tool output is accepted blindly

kernel_components.name: Recovery and Resumability
kernel_components.purpose: Handle crashes, retries, partial completion, duplicate prevention, rollback, compensation, and resume points.
p0_blockers: external actions can duplicate after retry
routine failure loses state
partial writes have no recovery path

kernel_components.name: Budget and Quota Manager
kernel_components.purpose: Enforce cost ceilings, token budgets, model quotas, API rate limits, routine budgets, and spend approvals.
p0_blockers: autonomous routine has no budget ceiling
paid vendor usage can run unchecked
no rate-limit fallback

kernel_components.name: Agent Registry and Role Model
kernel_components.purpose: Define agent roles, owners, allowed models, tools, memory, actions, escalation paths, and review cadence.
p0_blockers: agents have overlapping authority without owner
agent can access tools outside its role
no escalation path

kernel_components.name: Human Control Surface
kernel_components.purpose: Expose approvals, pending actions, memory review, traces, pause/stop, rollback/revoke, and escalation controls.
p0_blockers: user cannot inspect important actions
no stop control for autonomous work
memory or external actions are invisible

domain_runtime_patterns.name: Social Content Operating System
domain_runtime_patterns.first_runtime_slice: capture idea -> retrieve voice/proof memory -> draft post -> score -> approval queue -> record outcome

domain_runtime_patterns.name: Customer Operations Agent
domain_runtime_patterns.first_runtime_slice: ingest ticket -> retrieve account context -> draft response or action -> approval threshold -> trace resolution

domain_runtime_patterns.name: Research Intelligence Agent
domain_runtime_patterns.first_runtime_slice: scheduled research -> source retrieval -> synthesis -> citation trace -> review queue -> learning update

domain_runtime_patterns.name: Creative Media Agent
domain_runtime_patterns.first_runtime_slice: creative brief -> generate asset -> quality review -> cost trace -> approval -> export

domain_runtime_patterns.name: Multi-Agent Build System
domain_runtime_patterns.first_runtime_slice: plan task -> assign worker -> sandbox execution -> review trace -> merge approval
